name: Diophantine Masking
description: Replaces the explicit "different options" constraint of 3-coloring with a mathematically equivalent but semantically opaque arithmetic condition (sum of assigned values must be a perfect square). By choosing specific large frequencies where only distinct pairs sum to a perfect square, models are prevented from deducing the 3-coloring equivalence during Chain of Thought. This forces them to implement a generic backtracking solver without crucial graph-coloring heuristics (like degree ordering), leading to a Time Limit Exceeded (TLE) on hard instances.
